slices.question: Сколько движений в регистре реализации ТМЦ?

fact.sql: WITH today AS (SELECT timezone('Europe/Chisinau', now())::date AS d) SELECT coalesce(round(sum(TRY_CAST(Всего AS DECIMAL(38,10))),2),0) FROM accumulationregister_реализациятмц, today WHERE CAST(Period AS TIMESTAMP) >= today.d - INTERVAL 1 day AND CAST(Period AS TIMESTAMP) < today.d

corpus.sql: WITH today AS (SELECT timezone('Europe/Chisinau', now())::date AS d) SELECT coalesce(round(sum(nums['Всего']),2),0) FROM search_corpus, today WHERE src_table='accumulationregister_реализациятмц' AND doc_date >= today.d - INTERVAL 1 day AND doc_date < today.d

fact.sql: WITH today AS (SELECT timezone('Europe/Chisinau', now())::date AS d) SELECT coalesce(round(sum(TRY_CAST(Всего AS DECIMAL(38,10))),2),0) FROM accumulationregister_реализациятмц, today WHERE CAST(Period AS TIMESTAMP) >= today.d - INTERVAL 2 day AND CAST(Period AS TIMESTAMP) < today.d - INTERVAL 1 day

corpus.sql: WITH today AS (SELECT timezone('Europe/Chisinau', now())::date AS d) SELECT coalesce(round(sum(nums['Всего']),2),0) FROM search_corpus, today WHERE src_table='accumulationregister_реализациятмц' AND doc_date >= today.d - INTERVAL 2 day AND doc_date < today.d - INTERVAL 1 day
